body.title: Senior AI / Computer Vision Engineer -  3D Reconstruction
body.aiReason: Job focuses on 3D computer vision, mesh manipulation, and web rendering—outside core data analytics, ETL, PowerBI, Tableau focus.
body.description:
We’re looking for an experienced AI / Computer Vision Engineer to help build a lightweight proof of concept for a new consumer health-tech experience.
The project involves using multiple consumer-uploaded images to generate an approximate interactive 3D representation, then visualising a transition between an initial state and an illustrative future state.
This is not an LLM/chatbot project. We’re specifically looking for someone strong in visual AI, computer vision and 3D geometry.
Initial scope
* Process multiple smartphone images of the same subject
* Detect and segment relevant visual features
* Identify landmarks / geometry from 2D imagery
* Generate, select or deform an existing 3D mesh to approximately represent the source imagery
* Create a second illustrative 3D state
* Animate the transition between both states
* Render the model interactively in a web browser
* Support basic rotation, zoom and state switching
We are deliberately starting with a lightweight proof of concept, rather than trying to solve the entire technical problem in V1.
Ideal experience
* Computer vision
* 2D-to-3D or multi-view reconstruction
* Image segmentation
* Landmark detection
* 3D geometry / mesh manipulation
* Point clouds
* Python
* PyTorch
* OpenCV
* Open3D / Trimesh or similar
* STL / OBJ / PLY workflows
* Three.js / WebGL is highly desirable
Experience in any of the following would be particularly relevant:
medical imaging, dental imaging, facial reconstruction, digital humans, body scanning, photogrammetry, AR/VR, anatomical modelling or image-to-3D systems.
What success looks like
For the first milestone, we want to provide a small set of sample images and have you produce:
1. An approximate browser-viewable 3D model derived or adapted from those images
2. A second predefined or generated future-state model
3. A smooth visual transition between the two
4. An interactive browser demo
Accuracy does not need to be clinical-grade for this initial POC. The priority is whether the experience can look convincing, personalised and polished enough for a consumer-facing product.
Engagement
Contract / paid POC initially, with potential for a substantially larger project if the prototype is successful.
Further details about the product and use case will be shared with shortlisted candidates under confidentiality.
When applying, please include:
* Examples of previous 3D reconstruction or computer vision work
* Any projects involving image-to-3D, meshes, point clouds or anatomical modelling
* Your recommended technical approach for a lightweight POC
* What you believe can realistically be achieved in the first 2–4 weeks
* Your availability
Please do not apply if your experience is primarily LLMs, chatbots or prompt engineering without substantial computer vision / 3D work.
